card.name: Toxic chemical exposure news text
card.fires_on: Marks within articles about BPA and lead exposure, mostly the space before a number, the B of BPA, or a year digit. It also appears on a name or punctuation in the same stories.

modes.label: Before a number
modes.description: The space or digit slot right before a figure such as an age, percentage, year or plastic number.

modes.label: Start of BPA
modes.description: The B that begins the chemical name BPA in leaching and animal-study sentences.
modes.example: All but four concluded that<< B>>PA caused damage to animals.

modes.label: Name or punctuation in the story
modes.description: A first name or a comma or period in a citation or abbreviation in the same kind of text.
modes.example: said<< Patricia>> Hunt, a professor at Washington State University

card.writes: It suppresses accumulate-type words, so it may steer the model away from continuing with accumulation wording.
card.plain: It fires in news-style passages about BPA and lead in plastics and water, on small pieces like number slots and the start of BPA.
